_comment: Per-test PCC gates for the qwen3_6_a3b module tests (mirrors TT's blackhole/qwen36 tests/pcc_thresholds.json). These are the CHECKPOINT-FREE module tests (random / per-module weights), so they run on a single Blackhole in CI without the 87GB HF checkpoint. Source of truth for the CI gate (see run_ci_tests.sh). NOTE: the tests currently hardcode these thresholds inline; adopt this file as the single source in a follow-up.
